svg.title: Homeish navigation idea samples
svg.desc: Ten sample mockups of ideas borrowed from Multi School ERP and AcadLynk, adapted to Homeish.
svg.text: Ideas to borrow: one sample each
Sample mockups for discussion · not built · pick the ones you want
Grouping and the hat switcher have their own sheets: navigation-grouping-options.svg, two-role-switch-options.svg
One search box in the top bar finds both pages and things to do. Only shows what
A "+" next to the bell opens the most common "new" actions for your role. Or show
the top 4 as buttons on the dashboard (AcadLynk style).
On the admin dashboard until the society is ready, then it hides itself. Could
A small page for each group
Click a group heading (for example Money) to see its pages with a one-line
Sub-pages become tabs at the top of one page instead of extra menu links. Homeish
already does this in some places (Accounts); make it the rule.
For owners with more than one flat. Today Home lists all flats together ("Flats
B-402, C-1101"). A switch would show one flat at a time.
Needs your call: one flat at a time, or all together?
Every Homeish feature with a one-line description and whether it is on. Turning
features on stays with you (the developer).
Water and power readings per flat
Load flats, residents and opening dues from Excel when a society joins, with a
check step before anything is saved.
Seen in: ERP Import Hub, AcadLynk
Events, meetings, amenity bookings and bill due dates in one month view. Each
entry has a word, not just a colour.
For people who are residents and also on the committee. Full comparison on
Only people with two roles see the switch. Each side keeps its own short menu and
home page, so "my bill" and "everyone's bills" never get mixed up.
